post.summary:
ListReviews retrieves a paginated list of customer reviews based on specified criteria.
Supports filtering by feedback source and staff members to facilitate
targeted analysis of customer satisfaction and service quality.
post.description:
Possible errors:
- INVALID_ARGUMENT if pagination parameters are invalid
- PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller lacks access rights
- NOT_FOUND if the business ID doesn't exist

parameters.name: body
parameters.description:
ListReviewsRequest encapsulates parameters for retrieving customer reviews.
Supports pagination and filtering to customize the result set based on
business needs and analysis requirements.

pagination.title:
Pagination parameters for handling large result sets
Required to manage data volume efficiently

businessId.title:
Business location identifier for scoping reviews
Required to ensure reviews are accessed within proper context

filter.title:
Filter criteria to apply to the review list
Optional. If not provided, returns all reviews

v1ListReviewsRequest.description:
ListReviewsRequest encapsulates parameters for retrieving customer reviews.
Supports pagination and filtering to customize the result set based on
business needs and analysis requirements.

sources.title:
Feedback channels to include in results
Optional. If empty, includes reviews from all sources

staffIds.title:
Staff members to filter reviews by
Optional. If empty, includes reviews for all staff

v1ListReviewsRequestFilter.description:
Filter specifies criteria for filtering the review list.
Allows targeting specific feedback sources and staff members.

nextPageToken.title:
Token for retrieving the next page of results
Empty if there are no more results

reviews.title:
List of reviews matching the request criteria
May be empty if no reviews match the filters

v1ListReviewsResponse.description: ListReviewsResponse contains the paginated list of reviews and metadata.

pageSize.title:
integer, Number of items to return per page.
Minimum: 1, Maximum: 500

pageToken.description:
string, Token for retrieving the next page.
Obtained from the previous page's response.
Leave empty for the first page.

v1Pagination.description:
The pagination object provides a standardized way to handle paginated results
across all API endpoints. It supports both cursor-based and offset-based
pagination, with configurable page sizes and sorting options. This ensures
consistent and efficient data retrieval for large result sets.

id.title:
Unique identifier for the review
Format: "rev_" followed by random characters

customerId.title:
ID of the customer who submitted the review
Required. Must be a valid customer ID

appointmentId.title:
ID of the appointment being reviewed
Required. Must be a valid appointment ID

staffIds.title:
IDs of staff members included in the review
May include multiple staff for team services

petIds.title:
IDs of pets involved in the reviewed service
May include multiple pets for group appointments

source.title:
Channel through which the review was submitted
Used for tracking feedback collection methods

score.title:
Customer satisfaction rating
Scale: 1 to 5, where 5 represents highest satisfaction

reviewTime.title:
When the review was submitted by the customer
Used for tracking feedback timeliness

createdTime.title:
When this review was created in the system
System-generated timestamp

lastUpdatedTime.title:
When this review was last modified
Updated on any review changes

v1Review.description:
Review represents customer feedback for services provided.
Each review is associated with a specific appointment and can include
ratings and comments about multiple staff members and pets. Reviews
help track customer satisfaction and service quality.

v1ReviewSource.description:
Source identifies the channel through which the review was submitted.
This helps track engagement across different feedback collection methods
and analyze response patterns.

 - SOURCE_UNSPECIFIED: Unknown or invalid source
Should not be used when creating new reviews
 - SMS: Review submitted via SMS message
Typically sent after service completion
 - GROOMING_REPORT: Review submitted through grooming report
Collected during service documentation
 - PET_PARENT_PORTAL: Review submitted through customer portal
Direct customer feedback channel
